name: FFS_FORM
description: Stores a complete list of forms configured in the system.

columns.name: FORM_ID
columns.description: Unique internal identificator of the form.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Unique label of the form. Used as external identificator .

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the form ('active', 'inactive', 'deleted').

columns.name: FIELDS
columns.description: List of used fields and properties separated by newline character. Each field is stored in format 'entity_id.field_name'. Each property is stored in format 'property_id'. Example: 809chr(38)n1.astatuschr(38)n5.srtype.

columns.name: UPDATED_AT
columns.description: Date and time of last modification.

columns.name: CREATED_AT
columns.description: Date and time of form creation. Example: 2019-02-22 16:46:59.

columns.name: MODIFIED_BY
columns.description: ID of the user. Reference to the FFS_USER -> USER_ID.

columns.name: VERSION
columns.description: Version of form content. Value is updated after each modification of the form content.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Indicates type of screen model record form or flow.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Field for the relation to the FFS_APPLICATION.APP_ID value.

columns.name: FUSION_BUSINESS_OBJECT
columns.description: Field for fusion attachments business object.

columns.name: FUSION_CATEGORY_LABEL
columns.description: Field for fusion attachments category label.

columns.name: PDF_OPTIONS
columns.description: Field for PDF generation options: generate (1), generate and save to Object Storage (2), generate and save to Fusion Attachments (3).

columns.name: HTML_TEMPLATE
columns.description: Field for the HTML template that will be used to generate PDF files.

columns.name: HTML_TEMPLATE_METADATA
columns.description: Field for the metadata of the HTML template that will be used to generate PDF files, JSON.

columns.name: OFFLINE_CONFIG
columns.description: Arrays of Organization IDs and User type IDs, JSON. A form will be cached offline for users belonging to Organizations or User types from arrays.
